hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: In this combinatorial game, Alice wins if and only if the sum of petals x + y is odd.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For x + y to be odd, either x is odd and y is even, or x is even and y is odd.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: The count of such pairs is exactly (n * m) // 2.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct integer arithmetic for parity pair count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over all pairs (x, y) takes O(n * m) time which exceeds 10^10.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce parity winning condition and express total odd pairs in closed form.
